title: Strata Flash-Next data map
snapshot: 2026-10-15 S27: S22 operation rollups, S24/S25 probes, S26/S27 EP correctness diagnostics
scope: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next ISTA GSQ-RCO IQ3_XXS on two Arc Pro B70 cards, Strata SYCL engine, EP/PUSH, batch MTP depth2 (opt-in), two 200000-token slots, INT8 KV, 32 GiB / 4-entry RAM parking, all 24576 experts resident (7152 on GPU0 + 17424 on GPU1), greedy.
warnings: Trace service times overlap: within a card (engines), across cards, and with CPU wall time. They are NOT additive and are not a latency budget.
ep_wait kernels spin on the device; their time counts as 'busy' in busy-union figures but is waiting, not work.

Profiled cycles are slower than clean runs: cold-capture average 129.97 ms/window is misleading; interior median 59.174 ms/cycle (traced) versus clean native 49.12-49.27 ms/window. Use clean benchmarks for any performance claim.
Logical byte figures are arithmetic from shapes and quant block sizes. Physical PCIe bytes, cache hit rates and bandwidth saturation were NOT measured.

Current EP transport is Level Zero IPC-mapped device memory written/read by kernels with flag counters. It is not an all-reduce or any oneCCL collective. oneCCL post-health checks are health checks, not serving performance.

S27 native/debug EP first reads can consume current inbox poison while immediate second/third reads pass. Debug records intended wait epochs. Cause unresolved; no production corruption or speed claim.

stages.title: GGUF / pack storage
stages.summary: Primary IQ3_XXS GGUF and runtime pack paths are on /mnt/vm_8tb (SATA). The second GGUF used for PLE resolves to /mnt/cache (NVMe). Expert weights are resident after startup; PLE can still read rows during requests.

stages.title: PLE / host embedding path
stages.summary: Enabled in S22 (--ple-gguf, --ple-io direct). Table has 320001536 rows; the second GGUF symlink resolves to NVMe /mnt/cache. PleReader first checks its 8-way host row cache, deduplicates/aligned-pages/sorts misses, and queues DirectFile reads. The SYCL Linux path uses a bounded worker pool of blocking O_DIRECT pread calls (default 64 workers, env override), not io_uring.

hypotheses.text: S26 same-depth C2 prototype is CPU-built after slot-order/context/error fixes, but GPU serving is untested and held for EP freshness investigation.

Same-depth C2 head pairing has about1.38-1.41ms/window ideal head saving at depth2, before extra graph/coordination overhead. A guarded opt-in source candidate is being prepared; no serving gain measured.

One-row head 995 us versus six-row head 2259 us: the head amortizes well across rows. Batching the two slots' same-depth drafts into one 2-row head could save GPU0 service time if the drafts are independent across slots. Needs dependency audit + clean A/B; bitwise parity between the different one-row/two-row kernel instantiations must be tested.
A reduced-vocabulary or top-k draft head would change draft behaviour, not target output; acceptance impact unknown.
